title: Hiragana spelling: long vowels and small kana — write the word
description: Short everyday words distinguish おう/おお, small っ, and small ゃ/ゅ/ょ from competing spellings.

reviewItems.skill: Spell かった (bought (past of かう))

review.provenance: Original agent-authored contracted hiragana spelling cues and word examples; no legacy CSV or F00 text reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original English prompts, translations and explanations; kana spellings and short common-word meanings are linguistic facts. No copied work or audio.

exercises.prompt: Type “high school” in hiragana (koukou). Both long o spellings in this word use おう; do not replace う with お.

stimulus.translation: English meaning and Latin-letter spelling cue; write the Japanese word.

exercises.explanation: こうこう means high school. Both long o spellings in this word use おう; do not replace う with お. The contrast こおこう is not accepted.

exercises.prompt: Type “large; big” in hiragana (ookii). The first long o here is written おお, not おう.

stimulus.translation: English meaning and Latin-letter spelling cue; write the Japanese word.

exercises.explanation: おおきい means large; big. The first long o here is written おお, not おう. The contrast おうきい is not accepted.

exercises.prompt: Type “bought (past of かう)” in hiragana (katta). The small っ doubles the following consonant; かた is a different spelling.

stimulus.translation: English meaning and Latin-letter spelling cue; write the Japanese word.

exercises.explanation: かった means bought (past of かう). The small っ doubles the following consonant; かた is a different spelling. The contrast かた is not accepted.

exercises.prompt: Type “photograph” in hiragana (shashin). Small ゃ combines with し; full-sized や would change the spelling.

stimulus.translation: English meaning and Latin-letter spelling cue; write the Japanese word.

exercises.explanation: しゃしん means photograph. Small ゃ combines with し; full-sized や would change the spelling. The contrast しやしん is not accepted.
